title: Expectation of an inserted-set indicator
statement: Let $A$ be a subset of an $n$-element set and let $i$ be an element of that set. The Shapley expectation of the indicator that inserting $i$ into the sampled subset gives $A$ is the sum of the Shapley probabilities of $A$ and $A\setminus\{i\}$ when $i\in A$, and is $0$ when $i\notin A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the ground set
$i$ is an element of the ground set
